name: Rainbow Neutralizer
desc: Neutralizers are fundamental chemicals frequently used in alchemy. Some refinements have resulted in this all-purpose one, which can be used with any and all potential ingredients.

eff.name: Synthesis: All Element Bonus
eff.desc1: Increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1] and quality by [Lv. x 1] when this ingredient and its slot have matching elements.

eff.name: Synthesis: Quality Up+
eff.desc1: Using this as an ingredient for synthesis increases the synthesized item's quality by [Lv. x 2].

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area
eff.desc1: Increases the item's resonance area by [Lv. x 1].
